note: Forbidden: sending an OPEN whose My Autonomous System is neither the global nor the locally configured ASN. TestMigrationOpenCarriesResolvedASN reads the OPEN buildOpen produces and asserts My AS and the Four-octet AS capability equal the global ASN before a Bad Peer AS and the locally configured ASN after it (assert.Equal MyAS, ASN4, capability ASN), red on any other AS. Negative: without migration configured the local AS is sent whatever the fallback flag holds.
